title: Managing Business Continuity Settings Using API

blocks.text: This article provides information for managing Private Access (ZPA) Business Continuity settings using APIs. All APIs are rate limited. To learn more, see Understanding Rate Limiting.

blocks.heading: Getting Details of Business Continuity Settings

blocks.text: To get details of client settings for a given customer:

blocks.item: Send a GET request to the following endpoint: /mgmtconfig/v1/admin/customers/{customerId}/businessContinuitySettings.
Provide the customerId, the ZPA tenant ID of the customer, in the request endpoint. For example: /mgmtconfig/v1/admin/customers/144118148382064640/businessContinuitySettings.

blocks.heading: Creating or Updating the Business Continuity Settings

blocks.item: Send a POST or PUT request to the following endpoint: /mgmtconfig/v1/admin/customers/{customerId}/businessContinuitySettings.
Provide the following:
Required Fields
To create or update Business Continuity settings, the following fields are required:
customerId: The ZPA tenant ID of the customer in the request endpoint. For example: /mgmtconfig/v1/admin/customers/145256180497776640/businessContinuitySettings.
idpEntityId: The identity provider (IdP) Entity ID for SAML configuration.
idpLoginUrl: The IdP login URL.
offlineDomain: The offline domain URL for Disaster Recovery fallback.
Optional Fields
You can add or update these fields:
idpCert: The IdP certificate for SAML validation.
encryptSamlResponse: Enable to encrypt SAML responses.
useExistingIdp: Enable to use the existing IdP configuration.
baAuthDomainCertId: The certificate ID for the Browser Access authentication domain.
siteSPCertId: The certificate ID for the service provider.
restrictionType: The type of access restriction.
newUserSupport: Enable to allow enrolling new users in Business Continuity.
sitecPreferred: Enable to prefer public cloud for connections.
switchTimeEnabled: Enable to switch users to the public cloud after maximum downtime.
maxAllowedDownTime: The maximum allowed downtime.
maxAllowedDownTimeUnit: The unit for the maximum amount of downtime in seconds (SECONDS), minutes (MINUTES), hours (HOURS), or days (DAYS).
maxAllowedSwitchTime: The maximum amount of time to switch users to public cloud.
maxAllowedSwitchTimeUnit: The unit of the maximum amount of switch time in seconds (SECONDS), minutes (MINUTES), hours (HOURS), or days (DAYS).
backupEnabled: Enable backup functionality.
backupBasedir: The base directory for backups.
backupScheduleType: The schedule type for backups.
backupScheduleValue: The schedule value.
backupMaxAllowedNum: The maximum number of backups to retain.
zscalerManaged: Indicates a Zscaler-managed Business Continuity configuration.
readOnly: Indicate if the configuration is read-only.
metaData: The service provider metadata.
Use the following JSON payload to provide the following information:
View the JSON payload.

blocks.text: A successful response returns code 201, meaning the client settings are created or updated. To learn more, see API Response Codes and Error Messages.

blocks.item: Send a DELETE request to the following endpoint: /mgmtconfig/v1/admin/customers/{customerId}/businessContinuitySettings/{id}.
Provide the following:
customerId: The ZPA tenant ID of the customer in the request endpoint. For example: /mgmtconfig/v1/admin/customers/145256180497776640/businessContinuitySettings.
id: The unique identifier of the Business Continuity settings.

blocks.text: A successful response returns code 204, meaning the client settings are deleted. To learn more, see API Response Codes and Error Messages.
